mechanism: Polyethylene glycol (PEG) based bowel preparation solutions may cause volume depletion and electrolyte abnormalities that increase zoledronic acid nephrotoxicity risk, particularly in patients with renal impairment.
action: Assess renal function before PEG bowel preparation in patients on zoledronic acid; ensure adequate hydration and consider timing separation if possible, especially in patients with baseline renal compromise.
